rejected_rule.statement: The central feature of the proposed mark, a picture of a boy, is so similar to the central feature of the registered mark as to be likely to deceive or cause confusion among consumers.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "This, at first blush, is the net impression-the Picture of a young boy. When no effort is made to recall the details, I cannot escape the impression that the details and differences in them are irrelevant to my mind and are not part and parcel of the central picture of a boy."

meta.parties: Suby and Another v. T. Suby Ltd
